Keep bilingual `content/` siblings `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md` with mirrored front matter; sync `title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`. YAML; ISO timestamps. Extend `layouts/partials/`, `layouts/shortcodes/`, never edit `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`. CSS: `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through `static/`; refresh generated `public/`/`resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Diagrams in `svg/` or beside Markdown; lowercase filenames, domain folders, media nearby. `#` page titles; `##`/`###` sections; lists/tables over HTML. Use `{{% notice %}}`, `{{< svg icon="..." >}}`, mermaid fences. Hugo Extended v0.120+.

Preview: `hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged` (http://localhost:1313/gt-user-manual/); `hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`. Deploy: `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`. Before every commit run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings`; add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Spot-check `public/search/index.json` and affected pages in Chromium/Firefox. Include regenerated `public/`; focused commits, imperative style. PRs list touched sections, link Grafioschtrader issues, attach styling screenshots/zipped `public/` previews, state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
